These are extended technical notes on topics I work with or find interesting. They are written at a level between a textbook and a research paper --- rigorous enough to be useful as references, but with enough motivation and context to serve as introductions for graduate students entering the subject.

Each note is tagged with a difficulty level:

- **Introductory**: Accessible to advanced undergraduates and beginning graduate students
- **Advanced**: Assumes graduate-level background in the relevant area
- **Research-level**: Touches on open problems and current research

Use the sidebar to navigate between topics.

---

## String Theory & Geometry

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon=false}
### [Brane Tilings and 4D Supersymmetric Field Theory](brane-tilings.qmd) {.unnumbered}
*Advanced / Research-level* --- Brane tilings, orientifold projections, geometric engineering of $\mathcal{N}=1$ SCFTs, brane bending, and S-duality.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon=false}
### [Mirror Symmetry and T-Duality](mirror-symmetry.qmd) {.unnumbered}
*Advanced* --- Calabi-Yau mirror pairs, T-duality, the SYZ conjecture, and connections to brane constructions.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon=false}
### [2D CFT, Orbifolding, and the Swampland](2d-cft-swampland.qmd) {.unnumbered}
*Advanced / Research-level* --- Virasoro algebra, modular invariance, orbifolds, zeta regularization, and swampland conjectures.
:::
